asOf: Census FT-900 country file, data through August 2026
note: US general imports of goods by country of origin, Census basis, million USD, not seasonally adjusted. Years are yyyymm. imp12 = sum of the 12 months ending in that month (Dec = calendar year). imp_m = that month alone, for the 30 largest suppliers plus a few the stories name. share12 = % of all US goods imports over the same 12 months. Aggregates (EU, regions, World) are not in the country values; the world total is in 'world'. Built by tools/build/tw_census.py from https://www.census.gov/foreign-trade/balance/country.xlsx.
